citations.quote: Planned treatment is the planned arm of the subject (DM.ARM).

statement: Planned treatment is the planned arm of the subject (DM.ARM).

citations.quote: Actual treatment is the actual arm of the subject (DM.ACTARM).

statement: Actual treatment is the actual arm of the subject (DM.ACTARM).

citations.quote: The treatment start date is the earliest start date of an exposure record with a dose.

statement: The treatment start date is the earliest start date of an exposure record with a dose.

citations.quote: The treatment end date is the latest end date of an exposure record with a dose.

statement: The treatment end date is the latest end date of an exposure record with a dose.

citations.quote: When a partial exposure date has a known month, it is completed with the first day of that month.

statement: A partial exposure date with a known month is completed with the first day of that month.

citations.quote: Study day 1 is the treatment start date.

statement: Study day 1 is the treatment start date.

citations.quote: The randomized set holds every randomized subject.

statement: The randomized set holds every randomized subject.

citations.quote: The safety set holds every randomized subject who received at least one dose of study treatment.

statement: The safety set holds every randomized subject who received at least one dose of study treatment.

citations.quote: Safety analyses group subjects by actual treatment.

statement: Safety analyses group subjects by actual treatment.
The efficacy-evaluable set holds every subject of the safety set with a baseline value and at least one post-baseline value of the vital sign WEIGHT.

citations.quote: The end of study treatment and the end of participation in the study are each recorded as a disposition event, with the subcategories "STUDY TREATMENT" and "STUDY PARTICIPATION" respectively.

statement: The end-of-study record is the disposition event record of the subject with the subcategory STUDY PARTICIPATION.

citations.quote: A partial adverse event start date with a known month is completed with the first day of that month, or with the treatment start date when it falls in that month.

statement: A partial adverse event start date with a known month is completed with the first day of that month, or with the treatment start date when it falls in that month.

citations.quote: An adverse event is treatment-emergent if it starts on or after the first dose; date and time are compared where both were collected, and dates alone are compared otherwise.

statement: An adverse event is treatment-emergent when it starts on or after the first dose, comparing date and time where both were collected and dates otherwise.

citations.quote: Treatment emergence ends 30 days after the treatment end date, that day included.

statement: Treatment emergence ends 30 days after the treatment end date, that day included.
An adverse event is related to study treatment when its causality is one of "UNLIKELY RELATED", "POSSIBLY RELATED", "PROBABLY RELATED", "RELATED".

citations.quote: The planned outputs include the adverse event summary table.

statement: The planned outputs include the adverse event summary table.

citations.quote: The efficacy-evaluable set is the analysis set for the adverse event summary table.

statement: The analysis set of the adverse event summary table is the efficacy-evaluable set.

citations.quote: The treatment columns of the adverse event summary table are in ascending order of dose, with placebo first.

statement: The treatment columns of the adverse event summary table are in ascending order of dose, with placebo first.

citations.quote: The adverse event summary table will include a total column that pools the treatment arms other than Placebo.

statement: A total column of the adverse event summary table pools the treatment arms other than Placebo.

citations.quote: In the adverse event summary table, percentages will be presented with 2 decimals, and a count of zero will be displayed together with its percentage.

statement: The number of decimals of percentages in the adverse event summary table is 2, and a count of zero is shown with its percentage.

citations.quote: Numbers displayed in the adverse event summary table will be rounded half to even.

statement: Displayed numbers in the adverse event summary table are rounded half to even.

citations.quote: The rows of the adverse event summary table are any event, related events, serious events, serious related events, fatal events, and events leading to discontinuation of study treatment.

statement: The rows of the adverse event summary table are any event, related events, serious events, serious related events, fatal events, and events leading to discontinuation of study treatment.
